hero.titleAccent: in the best climate in the world.
hero.body: A tennis and padel academy for every age and level. Our own methodology, coaches with international experience, and personal attention in every session.

phil.title: One methodology, five coaches, a plan for every player.
phil.body: Every Darrod coach works to the same methodology, designed exclusively by the academy. Players train with several coaches during their development: each professional brings something personal to the process and enriches the player's game.

principles.body: Small groups by age and level. Individual attention guaranteed even in group sessions.

principles.title: Video analysis
principles.body: Biomechanical study and game patterns, used to design the best plan for technical improvement.

principles.title: A competitive environment
principles.body: Intensive training that builds a winning mentality, on court and beyond it.

programasPage.title: For every age and every level.
programasPage.intro: Three paths, one methodology. Choose your starting point and we build the route.
programasPage.methodologyTitle: The same methodology across all three

junior.format: Groups by age and level · individual lessons available
junior.intro: The starting point for players aged 6 to 18. We build technique from footwork and balance up, with a biomechanical study of each player, and take the first steps into competition once the player is ready.
works: Baseline, net and serve technique, starting from footwork
Individual biomechanical study and improvement plan
Coordination and physical preparation adapted to age
First competitions with a coach alongside

pro.intro: For competitive players ready to step up. We work every variation of spin, match strategy and game patterns, and adjust psychology and physical preparation to each player's needs.
works: Every variation of spin and its tactical use
Match strategy and a player's own game patterns
Reading the opponent and decisions under pressure
Sports psychology and individual physical preparation

coaching.intro: Support in competition and sports advice. We plan the tournament calendar with the player and their family, and hold regular meetings to adjust goals and expectations.
works: Match analysis and adjustments between rounds
Follow-up meetings with player and family

equipoPage.title: Coaches with international experience.
equipoPage.intro: Every Darrod coach works to the same training methodology, designed exclusively by the academy. During their development, players work with several coaches, and each one brings something personal to the process.

method.title: Video analysis
method.body: We record drills to find game patterns and analyse each player's technique. That study is the basis for the improvement plan.

method.title: Several coaches
method.body: We schedule sessions with different coaches. Each professional brings something personal to the process and broadens the player's understanding.

method.title: A personal approach
method.body: We keep a common methodology but adapt the process to each player. Groups are formed by age and level.

method.title: A competitive environment
method.body: The programmes aim to improve the game in a demanding training environment, also building independence and handling pressure.

bios.daniel-rodriguez: Director of the academy and owner of the Darrod methodology. He coordinates the coaching team and the follow-up of competition players.
bios.daniel-gonzalez: Coach in the competition area. He works on match strategy, game patterns and tournament preparation.
bios.laurent-dairiam: Coach on the Tennis Pro programme. He focuses on spin variations, tactics and reading the opponent.
bios.javier-anibal: Coach on the Junior programme. He builds technique from footwork up and guides the first steps into competition.
bios.alberto-ottchota: Padel coach. He runs individual and group lessons, and the holiday adult groups.

reservarPage.title: Book your lesson.
reservarPage.intro: Choose the lesson type, the number of players and a slot in the calendar. We check coach and court availability and confirm by email within 24 hours.
reservarPage.graciasBody: Thank you. We have logged your request and will write within 24 hours with the assigned coach, the court and the meeting point.

torneos.title: Tournaments in Gran Canaria.
torneos.intro: Gran Canaria hosts more than nine international tournaments each season. The academy supports its players across the local, national and international calendar.
torneos.note: Dates and categories follow each circuit's official calendar.

hoteles.title: Train wherever you are.
hoteles.body: With our in-hotel service we keep your training going on holiday too. An academy coach comes to your hotel court at the agreed time. It is an exclusive service for an additional fee.

steps.title: Tell us where you are staying
steps.body: Hotel, dates and the players' level.

steps.title: We confirm court and coach
steps.body: We check the hotel court's availability and assign a coach.

steps.title: Train without travelling
steps.body: The coach comes to your hotel at the agreed time.

precios.title: Rates per hour.
precios.body: The price is per lesson hour, regardless of level. It is shared across the players in the group, so the more players, the lower the cost per person.
precios.note: Multi-lesson passes, long stays and holiday adult groups: ask for terms.
